title: KCS U3c step 0: the LOS paper's Conjecture 1.2 IS the consecutive-pair statement - its q=4 census prediction (1+delta)/2 = 0.545634 at 1e8 sits 52 sigma BELOW the measured 0.556519; the conjecture's error budget O(x/(log x)^(11/4)) = 0.0057 in fraction terms at 1e8 is the SAME ORDER as the 0.0062 residual, and the paper's flagged (loglog/log)^2 lower-order term = 0.0083 at 1e8 is also the right size - the residual is inside the source's own error budget; 'transfer coefficient' reframed as the measured residual R(X) with three live ansatz families
claim: No RH claim: analysis of a published (unproven) main conjecture's stated size against our four-scale measurement. The 52-sigma statement is against the CONJECTURE's prediction, not a proved result; the honest framing is that the measured residual is inside the conjecture's own error budget, with the next term named (the paper's own (loglog/log)^2 flag).
evidence: Paper fetch (ar5iv rendering of arXiv:1603.03720, identity-checked at the fetch, answer-mode): Eq (5.1) main-conjecture form pi(x, 4, (a,a')) = li(x)/4 * (1 +/- (1/(2 log x)) log(2 pi log x / 4)) + O(x/(log x)^(11/4)); Conjecture 1.2 (q = 4): pi(x,4,(a,-a)) - pi(x,4,(a,a)) = x/(4 (log x)^2) * log(2 pi log x / 4) + O(x/(log x)^(11/4)) - per ordered pattern, so the census family fraction = (1+delta)/2

Sizing at 1e8: (1+delta)/2 = 0.545634 vs measured 0.556519 (z ~ 52); the Cramer-tilt model 0.550315 (z ~ 30); naive composition 0.595110 (z ~ +186). Error budget O(x/(log x)^(11/4)) in fraction terms: 33,069 gaps / 5.79e6 total ~ 0.0057 at 1e8 - the same order as the residuals 0.009056/0.006204/0.005714/0.005167 (1e7..1e9)

The paper flags: 'there may be additional non-oscillating lower-order terms of size (log log x / log x)^2, i.e. O(x (log log x)^2/(log x)^3), which can be visible in computable ranges' - at 1e8 the (loglog/log)^2 scale = 0.0333 in ratio terms ~ 0.0083 in fraction terms: the right size for the 0.0062 residual

Residual reframing: R(X) = measured - u3-only: 0.009056 (1e7) / 0.006204 (1e8) / 0.005714 (3e8) / 0.005167 (1e9); decays 43% over two decades - faster than delta (16% over the same span), slower than (loglog/log)^2 (64%). Ansätze: C(X)*(loglog/log)^2 with C = 0.6089/0.3724/0.4739/0.4832 (NOT constant - kills the pure-power ansatz at 1e7); the U3b alpha(X)*delta/2 form; or mixed. The 1e10 measurement discriminates

Factor bookkeeping check: the paper's difference formula x/(4 log^2 x)*ln(2 pi ln x/4) = 247,689 at 1e8 vs the per-pattern li/4*2delta = 264,293 - ratio 1.067 = li(1e8)/(1e8/ln 1e8) exactly, confirming the per-ordered-pattern reading of Conjecture 1.2
